entities.name: Sacred Heart Church, St. Petersburg
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sacred Heart Church is a Catholic church, built in the neo-Gothic style located in the Russian city of Saint Petersburg in northern Russia and part of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Moscow. It is dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus and is located at 57 Babushkin street.
